svg.title: Same observations, different predictions
svg.desc: The observations (0,1), (1,3), and (2,5) fit both the straight line y=2x+1 and the alternative y=2x+1+0.2x(x−1)(x−2). At input 3 they predict 7 and 8.2. The region beyond the last observed input, 2, is shaded. A solid line marks the straight fit, a dashed line the curved alternative.
